notes: One complete six-scene FixReach ad. This is a visual planning draft only; align exact scene boundaries to the imported narration and use the supplied Sid and Lala Bhai character pack. Do not render until the user reviews and approves the storyboard.

scenes.title: The Problem
scenes.dialogue_cue: Lala: enquiries aa rahi hain, confirmed home service bookings nahi
scenes.visual_description: Open hard on Lala Bhai looking frustrated beside a phone flooded with enquiry notifications. Cut between incoming calls and an empty booking calendar. Kinetic Hinglish typography emphasizes ENQUIRIES vs BOOKINGS.

scenes.title: Sid Enters
scenes.dialogue_cue: Sid jokes phone garam, business thanda; Lala lists poor enquiries
scenes.visual_description: Sid pops into frame with a playful entrance. Phone heats up with comic visual steam while a cold, empty service calendar sits beside Lala. Show three quick bad-enquiry beats: price-only, outside service area, later.

scenes.title: The Realization
scenes.dialogue_cue: Quantity is not the problem; quality is
scenes.visual_description: Sid reframes the problem. A flood of generic enquiry bubbles collapses into a smaller set of relevant customer cards. Punch in on QUALITY with a sharp kinetic type hit.

scenes.title: The FixReach Solution
scenes.dialogue_cue: FixReach and the three qualifying questions
scenes.visual_description: Show a clean, animated lead qualification flow with three large prompts: PROBLEM? LOCATION? WHEN? Use simple repair icons and a home-service booking journey. Keep claims to better-qualified enquiries and booking opportunities; no guaranteed bookings.

scenes.title: The Payoff
scenes.dialogue_cue: Lala understands; technician knows which home to visit
scenes.visual_description: Lala has a realization moment. Show a technician receiving a clear service card and route-to-home cue, with Sid affirming. Use the actual supplied character artwork and expressive poses.

scenes.title: CTA
scenes.dialogue_cue: Repair business owners comment LEADS for a free Campaign Audit
scenes.visual_description: High-energy direct-to-camera character delivery. Finish on a bold clean end card: FIXREACH / COMMENT LEADS / GET YOUR FREE CAMPAIGN AUDIT / Find out what's working, what's not, and where your campaigns can improve.

final_on_screen_text: Find out what's working, what's not, and where your campaigns can improve.
